title: CLI Runtime Flag Propagation — PRT Family Flag ABI Fix

abi_fix.old: std::string g_prt_sidecar_apply_family (C++ ABI incompatible across SO boundary)
abi_fix.new: char g_prt_sidecar_apply_family[64] + size_t g_prt_sidecar_apply_family_len (POD, no ABI issues)
abi_fix.copy_method: memset + strncpy + explicit null terminator + strlen update

key_symptoms_fixed: undefined reference to g_prt_sidecar_apply_family[abi:cxx11] linker error
family flag staying empty or garbage even when --prt-sidecar-apply-family was set
llama_set_prt_flags() never called in CLI because PRT_SIDECAR_PAGER_EXPERIMENTAL not defined for llama-cli compilation unit

A_BASELINE.evidence: Clean exit, no PRT hooks invoked

D_ATTN_OUT_SCALE_1.evidence: [PRT-FLAGS-SET] apply=1 true_inj=1 layer=0 family_len=8; pager lazy activation confirmed

H_MISSING_MANIFEST.evidence: common_init_result: PRT sidecar pager manifest not found: /tmp/nonexistent.json

two_pass_architecture_timing_caveat: In single-turn (--single-turn), the PRT sidecar pager uses lazy activation (Phase 28BN). Family flag filtering is applied at graph-construction time (first pass) via strncmp() in llama-graph.cpp. Budget enforcement and pager activation happen at decode time (second pass). This means family targeting decisions are made before the pager's layer activation occurs. For multi-turn scenarios, the two-pass behavior may cause timing-sensitive tests to see inconsistent family filtering if --prt-sidecar-apply-layer changes mid-session without a graph rebuild.
unblocked_reason: Family flag now propagates correctly from llama_set_prt_flags() through libllama.so into llama-graph.cpp. 29B-R (repeat injection guard) depends on g_prt_sidecar_apply_family being correctly set when targeting specific families. The char[64]+size_t ABI fix enables this.
